scope: wind-matched same-background methane interventions for fold-3/fold-4 cross-fit scene ranking

simulation.positive_source: real CH4 enhancement and mask from a positive scene in the same fitting fold
simulation.background: clear, onshore, no-plume scene from the same fitting fold and requested sensor
simulation.orientation: rotate source plume from source wind vector to target wind vector
simulation.spectral_method: released MARS-S2L MODTRAN integrated-transmittance LUT attenuating target B11/B12
simulation.sensor_balance: exactly 1024 Sentinel-2 and 1024 Landsat interventions per fitting fold

runtime.simulation: serial deterministic generation with batched four-view frozen-teacher inference

invariants: The fold-3 cache uses only fold-3 plume fields and fold-3 no-plume backgrounds; likewise for fold 4.
No held-fold label or imagery enters the opposite branch's fitting cache.
Wind matching is strictly <=1.5 m/s; unlike the earlier fallback implementation, a farther nearest plume is never accepted.
The same frozen released U-Net and 28-channel counterfactual transform encode real and simulated scenes.
The upstream 16-channel mixed Sentinel-2/Landsat contract is preserved.
Folds 0, 1, and 2 and all exact-paper or fresh-external inputs are forbidden.
Bulk simulation arrays remain Git-ignored and only a compact receipt is committed.
